definition.title: Regional pulmonary surrogate for contract verification

validity.description: Three serial regions with deterministic durations selected solely to verify interchangeable composition.

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M3 body-organ coupling contract tests, version 1.0.0

limitations: All regional durations are test values and are not physiological evidence.
Region labels are structural and do not identify imported anatomical vessels.
The model has no pressure, resistance, branching, uncertainty, or gas exchange.
